evidence.quote: talk to him and he will give you the Rod to help you complete your quest through the Earth Cave.

subject: Rod

subject: Lich
text: Lich has 400 HP.

evidence.quote: BOSS BATTLE: Lich      HP: 400

subject: Lich
text: Fire spells cast by mages are the best strategy against Lich.

evidence.quote: Fire is your best bet to winning this match. Use fire spells from your mages and have the other party members attack as normal.

subject: Lich
text: Casting Slow on Lich lessens his physical attack damage, especially if he casts Fast on himself, and party HP should be kept above 70.

evidence.quote: Watch for Lich to cast Fast on himself...after that once he hits you, you're out...or almost out. Cast slow on Lich to lessen the effects of his physical attacks(because they are rather powerful). Keep your HP up above 70 and attack constantly.

subject: black orb
text: Stepping up to the black orb after defeating Lich causes your orb to shine and teleports you outside automatically.

evidence.quote: After the battle step up to the black orb and your orb will shine(on your status screen), then you will be teleported outside automatically

evidence.quote:
Once inside talk to the 12 sages...one of them will give you a canoe to

subject: Exit
text: It is extremely important to acquire the spell Exit in Crescent Lake.

evidence.quote:
In this town it's extremely important that you attain the
spell "Exit."

subject: lava
text: Walking on lava drains HP for every step taken, but standing still on it does not decrease HP.

evidence.quote:
Once
inside, the searing pools of lava will drain your HP for every movement that
you take on them. Meaning that even if you stand on the floors, you will
not gradually decrease in HP.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: The west path in Gurgu Volcano leads to the Flame Armor.

evidence.quote:
There are only two paths that are really
important, that's the west path(which leads to the Flame Armor) and the
southwest path, which leads to Kary.

subject: Kary
text: Kary has 600 HP.

evidence.quote: BOSS BATTLE: Kary      HP: 600

subject: Kary
text: Equipping Flame Armor lessens damage from Kary's fire magic.

evidence.quote:
You're best bet to
winning this battle is to hope that Kary uses her fire magic on any character
that is wearing the Flame Armor(hopefully you were smart enough to equip it
on as you had recieved it :P ). This way the damage is lessened and the party
can constantly barrage her with attacks.

subject: Kary
text: Against Kary, attack with Lit2 or Ice2, cast Slow on Kary, and cast Fast on fighters, black belts, and thieves.

evidence.quote:
Fire, surprisingly, does damage to
Kary as well...it's odd but eh. Attack with magic like Lit2 or Ice2 and cast
Slow on Kary and Fast on your fighters, black belts, and theifs.

evidence.quote:
Ice Cave
Party's level: 22

subject: Flame Sword
text: In the Ice Cave, equip the Flame Sword but unequip Flame Armor because ice nulls fire defense and attack.

evidence.quote:
Before you go anywhere in this ice cave, it is imperative that you equip your
Flame Sword but de-equip any Flame Armor that you may have. If not you can
suffer a lot of damage since ice will null any fire defense and attack.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: A chest to the left in the Ice Cave contains Ice Armor, which protects against ice attacks.

evidence.quote:
To the left of where you are is Ice Armor, which
is extremely valuable in a place like this since you can protect yourself
from ice attacks from the monsters here.
